text:
kevin: Heads-up: support saw a customer flow where repeated 429s + aggressive context trimming during embeddings migration produced garbage outputs. Our error-ref mentions fallbacks but no concrete SDK snippet. Need a tiny, copy-pasteable pattern and a short runbook we can drop into the error-reference page.

sarah: I can draft the snippet. Want JS + Python or keep it to one canonical example?

maya: Both. Most requests are for both languages. Keep examples minimal: detect 429, trim context, optionally downgrade model, and retry with backoff. 6-10 lines each.

jordan: Add telemetry notes: use `retry_reason` and `fallback_model` tags so the Console can surface regressions. We already have those fields in the SDK.

sarah: Draft Python snippet (compact):
```python
# on 429: trim context, fallback to smaller model, retry once with backoff
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-large-v1", prompt=long_prompt, max_tokens=1024)
except RateLimitError:
    client.metrics.increment("client.retry", tags={"retry_reason": "context_trim"})
    short_prompt = trim_context(long_prompt, keep_last_tokens=2048)
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-small-v1", prompt=short_prompt, max_tokens=256)
```

kevin: Good. Add a one-paragraph explanation of tradeoffs (quality vs cost/latency) and when to avoid auto-downgrades (e.g., sensitive/legal content).

sarah: Added the blurb in the PR branch. Will also add JS.

maya: For the runbook, keep it as 5 bullets: reproduce minimal case, confirm 429s (not infra), try local trimming, add snippet to app, monitor Console fallback rate.

jordan: Also link to the SDK `retry_reason` docs and the Console dashboard for `client.retry`. I can add the dashboard URL after PR is up.

sarah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — includes Python + JS snippets, runbook bullets, and telemetry note. PTAL @kevin @jordan.

kevin: Reviewing. Request: make the JS sample show both exponential backoff and an immediate model fallback so frontend teams can show a "degraded experience" banner if fallback occurs.

sarah: Updated JS to include backoff and a model downgrade path; kept it compact. Pushed fix.

docs-bot: Lint check: OK. Link scanner flagged one relative link pointing to /old-error-ref 9 suggest /error-reference/429 instead.

sarah: Fixed link, pushed.

maya: After merge, can we add a one-line example in the migration guide showing the Console event name `client.retry` + tags `retry_reason` and `fallback_model` so customers can map alerts to our guidance?

jordan: Yes — that single sentence is enough. I9ll add the dashboard link once the PR merges.

kevin: LGTM. Approving after JS backoff is present. This should let support point customers to a runnable pattern. :thumbsup:

sarah: All set, merged.

maya: I'll add a changelog entry: "Add 429 + context-trim runbook and SDK fallback snippets (Python/JS)" so support can reference the change.

kevin: Thanks everyone. If support gets another repro, we'll iterate on the snippet and add more instrumentation examples.
